prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Nothing independent confirms the accident: no witnesses, no photos and no other report.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On arrival at the signalized intersection, I found a side-impact collision between two passenger vehicles. The front driver's door of Driver 2's vehicle was pushed inward, and the rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle showed matching crush damage consistent with the reported angle of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee and was transported for evaluation. Driver 1 presented a policy document listing Driver 1 as the named insured on the vehicle. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle, and I observed Passenger at the scene. A bystander who had come out of a nearby building also confirmed that Passenger had been riding in that vehicle. No independent witness reported seeing the collision itself. No photographs were submitted by either party, and I located no other report of this incident. A few older scratches are visible on Driver 1's bumper, and they may predate this crash. Both drivers were cited for further review pending the investigation.
